newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Wall St chilly on Tues stock issues.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Wall St chilly on Tues stock issues.

text.p: Wall Street gave Tuesday's batch of initial public offerings a cool reception, with only one new issue pulling out a solid first-day premium.
Mego Mortgage Corp shares rose 1-1/4 to 11-1/4, although the gain was tempered by its low IPO price of $10 a share. The deal was expected to price at $11 to $13 a share.
Shares of Ticketmaster Group Inc broke issue, or fell below their initial public offering price, on their first day of trading, falling 3/8 to 14-1/8 at midday from their IPO price of $14.50 each.
Analysts had said they expected the IPO to perform well only if investors ignored the company's weak finances and opted for its strong name recognition.
Ticketmaster had consolidated long-term debt of $183.6 million at July 31, 1996. It posted a net loss of $2.4 million, or $0.16 a share, for the six month period ended July 31, 1996.
Other initial public offerings also met with mixed greetings from Wall Street.
